meta.name: BuzzFeed Celeb
meta.description:
From the latest celebrity headlines to favorite
hilariously mundane happenings, BuzzFeed is here to
keep you updated on what all your favorite celebs
are up to.

Shows: Best Of Puppy Interviews, Movie & TV Castmates Play Who's Who, Jennifer Aniston & Reese Witherspoon Play With Puppies, Tom Hiddleston & Chris Hemsworth Play With Puppies, Ryan Gosling & Ryan Reynolds Play With Puppies
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
